title: Long Horizon — an agent harness on ADK
description: A reference implementation of a long-horizon agent harness on ADK and Google's Agent Platform: cross-session memory, a per-user sandbox, tool guardrails, sub-agents, and a self-improvement loop.
source: no-capture — brief-supplied material (google/adk-samples core/python/long-horizon-harness README + docs); palette sampled from the sample's own banner art and web-UI demo
notes: Cyan #5CE1F2 is the glowing agent-graph in the project's banner; amber #F0A25C is that banner's sunset; indigo #6366F1 is the Horizon web UI's chat accent. Canvas is near-black by explicit brief requirement (dark theme).
